import math, random
rows=[]
for line in open('/app/graphene.dat'):
 a,b=line.strip().split('\t'); rows.append((float(a.replace(',','.')),float(b.replace(',','.'))))

def linfit(q, ys):
 n=len(q); sq=sum(v*v for v in q); s=sum(q); sy=sum(y for y in ys); sqy=sum(v*y for v,y in zip(q,ys)); den=sq*n-s*s
 if abs(den)<1e-20: return 0,sy/n
 a=(sqy*n-sy*s)/den; o=(sq*sy-s*sqy)/den
 return a,o

def calc(data,x0,gamma):
 q=[1/(1+((x-x0)/gamma)**2) for x,y in data]
 a,o=linfit(q,[y for x,y in data])
 return sum((y-(o+a*v))**2 for (x,y),v in zip(data,q)),a,o

def fit(data, x0, gamma):
 # coordinate descent with relative step then shrink
 best=calc(data,x0,gamma)
 for it in range(1000):
  changed=False
  for idx in [0,1]:
   val=[x0,gamma][idx]
   step=(0.1 if idx==0 else 0.1)*val
   # try +-step repeatedly, shrinking when no improvement
   cand=[]
   for z in [val-step,val+step]:
    if idx==1 and z<=0: continue
    p=[x0,gamma]; p[idx]=z
    c=calc(data,*p)
    cand.append((c,p))
   if cand:
    c,p=min(cand,key=lambda z:z[0])
    if c[0] < best[0]:
     x0,gamma=p; best=c; changed=True
     continue
   # no improvement: find optimum 1d via ternary-ish golden on val+-step
   # simple shrink
   if idx==0: x0=val
   else: gamma=val
   # store step impossible; use optimizer loop with dynamic based on absolute current
  if not changed:
   # do fine grid around current using steps
   improved=False
   for idx in [0,1]:
    val=[x0,gamma][idx]
    step=(0.01 if idx==0 else 0.01)*val
    for mult in [-1,1]:
     p=[x0,gamma];p[idx]=val+mult*step
     if p[1]<=0:continue
     c=calc(data,*p)
     if c[0]<best[0]: x0,gamma=p;best=c;improved=True
   if not improved: break
 return x0,gamma,best[1],best[2],best[0]
# Instead use grid initial then coordinate descent above
for center in [3745,6329,10500,16245,17100,17500]:
 print('\nCENTER',center)
 for hw in [50,75,100,150,200,300,400,600,800]:
  data=[r for r in rows if center-hw<=r[0]<=center+hw]
  if len(data)<5: continue
  # grid initial x max, gamma fractions
  mx=max(data,key=lambda z:z[1])[0]
  best=None
  for x0 in [center,mx,center-10,center+10]:
   for g in [5,10,20,30,50,75,100,150,200,300,500]:
    if best is None or calc(data,x0,g)[0]<best[0]: best=(calc(data,x0,g)[0],x0,g)
  out=fit(data,best[1],best[2])
  print('hw',hw,'n',len(data),'xmax',mx,'fit x0 g A o rmse',*(round(v,5) for v in out[0:4]),round(math.sqrt(out[4]/len(data)),2))

import math
rows=[]
for line in open('/app/graphene.dat'):
 a,b=line.strip().split('\t'); rows.append((float(a.replace(',','.')),float(b.replace(',','.'))))

def linfit(q, ys):
 n=len(q); sq=sum(v*v for v in q); s=sum(q); sy=sum(y for y in ys); sqy=sum(v*y for v,y in zip(q,ys)); den=sq*n-s*s
 if abs(den)<1e-20: return 0,sy/n
 a=(sqy*n-sy*s)/den; o=(sq*sy-s*sqy)/den
 return a,o

def calc(data,x0,lg):
 gamma=math.exp(lg)
 q=[1/(1+((x-x0)/gamma)**2) for x,y in data]
 a,o=linfit(q,[y for x,y in data])
 return sum((y-(o+a*v))**2 for (x,y),v in zip(data,q)),a,o

def nm(data,x0,gamma):
 # objective x0, log gamma, simplex with scale
 p=[x0,math.log(gamma)]
 steps=[max(1,(max(x for x,y in data)-min(x for x,y in data))/20), .5]
 simp=[p[:], [p[0]+steps[0],p[1]], [p[0],p[1]+steps[1]]]
 vals=[calc(data,*z)[0] for z in simp]
 for it in range(1000):
  order=sorted(range(3),key=lambda i: vals[i]); simp=[simp[i] for i in order]; vals=[vals[i] for i in order]
  if max(abs(simp[i][0]-simp[0][0]) for i in range(1,3))<1e-7 and max(abs(simp[i][1]-simp[0][1]) for i in range(1,3))<1e-8: break
  c=[sum(simp[i][j] for i in [0,1])/2 for j in range(2)]
  # reflect worst
  r=[c[j]+(c[j]-simp[2][j]) for j in range(2)]; vr=calc(data,*r)[0]
  if vals[0] <= vr < vals[1]: simp[2]=r;vals[2]=vr;continue
  if vr < vals[0]:
   e=[c[j]+2*(r[j]-c[j]) for j in range(2)]; ve=calc(data,*e)[0]
   if ve<vr:simp[2]=e;vals[2]=ve
   else:simp[2]=r;vals[2]=vr
   continue
  # contract
  cc=[c[j]+.5*(simp[2][j]-c[j]) for j in range(2)]; vc=calc(data,*cc)[0]
  if vc < vals[2]: simp[2]=cc; vals[2]=vc;continue
  # shrink
  for i in [1,2]:
   simp[i]=[simp[0][j]+.5*(simp[i][j]-simp[0][j]) for j in range(2)]
   vals[i]=calc(data,*simp[i])[0]
 best=simp[0]; c=calc(data,*best)
 return best[0],math.exp(best[1]),c[1],c[2],c[0],it
for center in [3745,6329]:
 print('\nCENTER',center)
 for hw in [40,50,75,100,125,150,200,250,300,400,600,800]:
  data=[r for r in rows if center-hw<=r[0]<=center+hw]
  if len(data)<8:continue
  # starts broad
  best=None
  for x0 in [center,max(data,key=lambda z:z[1])[0],center-10,center+10]:
   for g in [5,10,20,30,40,50,75,100,150,200]:
    o=nm(data,x0,g)
    if best is None or o[4]<best[4]:best=o
  print('hw',hw,'n',len(data),'fit',*(round(v,6) for v in best[:4]),'rmse',round(math.sqrt(best[4]/len(data)),3),'it',best[5])
